It is a statement of intent and records no results.", "artifacts": [{"kind": "verification_plan", "title": "tick_timer verification plan", "summary": "The plan serves [requirement:req-f7e179000a]. It quotes each of the 15 [req:ID]-tagged requirements of the approved spec [artifact:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.a1], with source interface_spec.md. Every requirement has at least one item: a directed or random test in tb_tick_timer.sv, an assertion in tick_timer_sva.sv, or both. The spec's own review is recorded as [evidence:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.e1]."}], "files": [{"path": "verification_plan.json", "kind": "verification_plan", "title": "tick_timer verification plan (nirmaan.vplan v1)", "summary": "This is a JSON plan in format nirmaan.vplan, version 1. It traces to [requirement:req-f7e179000a] and covers every tagged requirement of [artifact:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.a1]: TMR-PARAM, RESET, REG-RW, READ, START, COUNT, WRITE-WINS, STOP, LOAD-LATE, EXPIRE, PERIODIC, ONESHOT, W1C, SET-WINS and IRQ. Each item states its stimulus and check in its rationale field. It has no result fields.", "entry": null}], "tool_runs": [], "claims": ["Requirement text is quoted verbatim from interface_spec.md, including the Markdown backticks, with the [req:ID] tag and the leading list marker removed. I assume the vplan.check quote comparison works on the raw item text. If it strips Markdown formatting first, the quotes may need adjusting.", "The item files tb_tick_timer.sv and tick_timer_sva.sv are planned files that do not exist yet. The existing RTL file name is not in my inputs.", "I planned no coverage_point items. coverage.read reads the coverage of design files, and the RTL file name is not in my inputs, so naming one would be a guess. Cover points such as mode x IE x expiry and the W values should be added once the RTL file is known.", "The CTRL and STATUS 'other bits read as zero' behaviour in the register map is not tagged as a requirement. It is observed inside the TMR-REG-RW and TMR-W1C tests but is not listed as a plan requirement."], "escalation": null, "notes": "No tool was run by me. The platform runs vplan.check against interface_spec.md, and that run is required before review. Independent review of this plan is still required and has not happened. TMR-PARAM needs regressions at several values of W (4, 16 and 32 at least)."}
=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_smoke", "proves": ["TMR-START", "TMR-COUNT", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "Smoke test. Stimulus: reset, write LOAD=5, write CTRL EN=1 MODE=0. Check: COUNT reads 5 after the start edge, then falls by one each edge to 0. One edge later STATUS.EXPIRED=1, CTRL.EN=0 and COUNT stays 0."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_param_widths", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run the same regression with W=4, W=16 and W=32. Stimulus: write LOAD=32'hFFFFFFFF, then start. Check: LOAD and COUNT read back with bits W and up equal to zero, and the count starts from 2^W-1."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_reset", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Stimulus: put the timer into a non-zero state (CTRL=7, LOAD set, counting, EXPIRED=1), then hold rst_n low for one or more edges, including mid-count. Check: CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS all read 0 after the reset edge, and irq is 0."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Property: a rising edge with !rst_n implies that CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS are 0 at the next sample."},
    {"id": "T-REGRW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_reg_rw", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Stimulus: random wdata written to CTRL and LOAD, with EN held 0 where possible so that counting does not interfere. Check: CTRL reads wdata[2:0] and LOAD reads wdata[W-1:0]. The upper CTRL bits are also observed to read 0."},
    {"id": "T-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_read_combinational", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: change addr between edges with we=0, and do many back-to-back reads of every address including STATUS. Check: rdata matches the selected register in the same cycle with no clock edge, and no register value changes because of a read."},
    {"id": "A-READ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_mux", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Immediate or concurrent check that rdata always equals the register that addr selects, zero-extended to 32 bits."},
    {"id": "T-START", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_start_load", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "Stimulus: with EN=0 and a stale COUNT, write CTRL with EN=1, for several LOAD values including 0 and the maximum. Also rewrite CTRL with EN=1 while EN is already 1. Check: the count loads LOAD only on the 0-to-1 transition, and a rewrite with EN already 1 does not reload."},
    {"id": "A-COUNT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_decrements", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Property: rst_n && EN && COUNT!=0 && !(we && addr==0) implies COUNT == $past(COUNT)-1 at the next sample."},
    {"id": "T-WRITEWINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_ctrl_write_wins", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: while running, write CTRL with EN still 1 (for example toggling MODE or IE) at a non-zero count and again at count 0. Check: the count does not fall at that edge, and EXPIRED is not set at that edge even when the count was 0."},
    {"id": "A-WRITEWINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_no_step", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Property: an edge with a CTRL write, EN already 1 and EN kept 1 leaves COUNT unchanged and does not newly set EXPIRED."},
    {"id": "T-STOP", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_stop_hold", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "Stimulus: start, run a few edges, then write CTRL with EN=0 and wait many edges. Check: COUNT holds its value, no expiry happens, and a later start reloads from LOAD."},
    {"id": "T-LOADLATE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_load_late", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: while counting, write a new LOAD value, in both one-shot and periodic mode. Check: COUNT continues from its old value at that edge. The new LOAD is used at the next periodic reload and at the next start."},
    {"id": "A-EXPIRE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_sets_flag", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Property: rst_n && EN && COUNT==0 && !(we && addr==0) implies EXPIRED is 1 at the next sample."},
    {"id": "T-PERIODIC", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_periodic", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: MODE=1 with LOAD=3, run through several periods, and include LOAD=0. Check: each expiry reloads COUNT with LOAD, EN stays 1, and the period is LOAD+1 edges."},
    {"id": "T-ONESHOT", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_oneshot", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "Stimulus: MODE=0, let the timer expire, then wait many edges, then start again. Check: EN clears at the expiry, COUNT stays 0 until the restart, and EXPIRED is not set again while stopped."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "Stimulus: with EXPIRED=1, write STATUS with bit 0 = 0, then with bit 0 = 1. With EXPIRED=0, write bit 0 = 1. Check: the write with bit 0 = 0 changes nothing, the write with bit 0 = 1 clears the flag, and no write ever sets it. The upper STATUS bits are observed to read 0."},
    {"id": "T-SETWINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_set_wins", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: time a STATUS write with bit 0 set to the exact expiry edge, in both modes. Check: EXPIRED is 1 after that edge."},
    {"id": "A-SETWINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_beats_clear", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Property: an expiry condition together with a STATUS write of bit 0 = 1 at the same edge implies EXPIRED is 1 at the next sample."},
    {"id": "T-IRQ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_irq", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: toggle IE while EXPIRED is 1 and while it is 0, and clear EXPIRED, in both one-shot and periodic mode. Check: irq equals EXPIRED && IE in every cycle, combinationally."},
    {"id": "A-IRQ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_flag_and_ie", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Invariant: irq == (STATUS.EXPIRED && CTRL.IE) at all times."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "tick_timer_random_ref_model", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT", "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "TMR-STOP", "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-W1C", "TMR-SET-WINS", "TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Stress test. Stimulus: constrained-random register traffic with small LOAD values so that expiries are frequent. Check: a cycle-accurate reference model built from the spec is compared against rdata and irq on every cycle."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
